page.layout: One printed page, title page set centred in lines. Right margin holds short side notes beside the list of names: "Consulibus", "Senatoribus Patriae secretioribus", "J. U. Doctoribus & Syndicis". A library stamp sits low in the centre and is omitted. Catchword "Sapien-" at lower right, below the last line.

page.notes: Side notes at right ("Consulibus", "Senatoribus Patriae secretioribus", "J. U. Doctoribus & Syndicis") are printed beside the name lines and are given here as note text in the list, not as separate margin notes. The library stamp ("Bibliotheca Regia Monacensis") is omitted. Possible misreadings: "SCHLOSBERGERO" and "SCHLOSBERGERO" spelling as printed; the list of names is set in mixed type. The final catchword "Sapien-" is partly obscured by the stamp edge.
